name: metmuseum
description: The Metropolitan Museum of Art collection search (metmuseum.org). No commands could be generated because the recording captured only a Vercel bot-check challenge and none of the site's real data requests.
notes: The only recorded endpoint (E1, POST /.well-known/vercel/security/request-challenge) belongs to Vercel's Security Checkpoint bot challenge. It is not a site capability. It carries one-time challenge tokens and solutions and was never sent, so it was left out on purpose. Replaying or automating it would mean trying to get past the bot protection.

Every page, including /art/collection/search, showed the checkpoint, so no search, object-detail, facet or pagination requests were recorded. Any command written now would be made up, not taken from the recording.

The Met publishes a documented, public Open Access API at https://collectionapi.metmuseum.org/public/collection/v1/ (e.g. /search?q=..., /objects/{objectID}, /departments). It did not appear in this recording, so no commands were built from it. To build a working CLI, explore that API host directly. It is meant for programmatic use and is not behind the Vercel checkpoint.
The explorer was not logged in. No user-specific or write capabilities were seen.
